Start URL: http://intranet.office.local:8300/
1. Click link "Legacy ERP".
2. Click link "Travel Request" in the "Requests" menu.
3. Type <destination city> into field "Destination city".
4. Click button "Pick from date".
5. Click button ">" in the table row "< <month from the request> <year from the request> >".
6. Click button <day from the request> in the table row "1 2 3 4 5 6 7".
7. Select the date <from date> for "From date" in the calendar.
8. Click button "Pick to date".
9. Click button ">" in the table row "< <month to the request> <year from the request> >".
10. Click button <day to the request> in the table row "6 7 8 9 10 11 12".
11. Select the date <to date> for "To date" in the calendar.
12. Click link "Submit".
